89 skins, one click

NikPak and unNik wear the same skins as Nikkomander, from Nikkoid Blue to Pizza, Matrix and 8-Bit Game. Pick one and both programs keep it.

How it works

  • Skins button: the palette button in the title bar opens the skins menu. The box opens beside the window, so the whole interface stays visible: click a skin to try it on the window.
  • Apply or cancel: the box can be dragged anywhere by its title bar. Apply Skin keeps the skin for NikPak and unNik; Cancel (or Esc) goes back to the one you had.
  • Sun and moon: the button next to it switches between Nikkoid Blue (dark) and Nikkoid Bright in one click, like in Nikkomander.
  • Remembered: the chosen skin is saved and used at the next start. NikPak and unNik share it: change it in one, the other follows within seconds.
  • Painted and flat: 75 skins from Nikkomander's CSS gradients - stripes, stars, bricks - and 14 new ones whose artwork NikPak draws itself: a storm, mountains at dusk, a neon street, old computers, a chessboard. They stay sharp at any window size. Since 1.6.2 the painted artwork steps behind the interface - softened and faded behind the title, the drop ring and the status text - so it never competes with the window.

Fourteen new painted skins

Moon, America, Pattaya Neons, Burgers Tokyo, Sushi, Amiga Computer, MSX Computer, Colecovision, ZX Spectrum, Cat Life, Dog Life, Mario Bros, Counter Strike and Chess: artwork drawn by NikPak itself, not a gradient, so it stays sharp at any window size.

NikPak in every skin. Click a picture to see it full size.

unNik too

The archive browser follows the same skin: folders, file icons, selection and dialogs take the skin's colours.

Your own skins

A skin is a small .skin.json file: a name and a list of colours, in the same format as Nikkomander. Click Import a skin… at the bottom of the skins menu: the file is copied to the skins folder next to the settings, and the × on its tile removes it again.

NikPak keeps its own fonts in every skin; the fonts and a few decorative borders of Nikkomander's skins are not used.
{
  "id": "ocean-glass",
  "name": "Ocean Glass",
  "dark": true,
  "vars": {
    "bg": "#06121f",
    "panel": "#0b2236",
    "dialog": "#0d2740",
    "fg": "#d7e6f2",
    "fg-dim": "#7897ad",
    "accent": "#4cc2ff",
    "accent-fg": "#031521",
    "border": "#1b4160",
    "danger": "#ff6b6b",
    "ok": "#6be3a4",
    "radius": "14px"
  }
}
